name: Defect or change report
trigger: a client reports delivered work wrong or missing

steps.name: Ingest
steps.means: A defect or change request comes in; master tasks an investigation.

steps.name: Investigate
steps.means: The client agent finds the cause and names the fix.
steps.next: result names a fix for the client agent

steps.name: Fix
steps.means: The client agent builds the fix and dev-compiles it; nothing is checked in yet.

spec.read_first: coord_get_task_result {prev} (the step before this one in case {case}: {root_title}).
constraints: Build and dev-compile only; do not check in.
Return compile: "clean" only when the build and dev-compile ran with no errors or warnings.

steps.name: Review
steps.means: A fresh agent checks the code against the CVC code checklist.

steps.name: Check-in approval
steps.means: The board approves the check-in on its own once the review passes, the files are unchanged and the compile is clean; otherwise Ben approves it.
steps.gate: checkin_auto: review approves, files unchanged, compile clean, veto window passed; else Ben approves the check-in

steps.name: Check-in
steps.means: The client agent checks the approved code into CVC.

steps.name: Pipeline note
steps.means: Master adds a note to the SharePoint pipeline item saying what landed.

steps.name: Reply
steps.means: The client agent drafts the reply telling the client it is fixed; nothing is sent.

spec.goal: Draft the reply to the client email this case answers ({root_title}), from the finished step's result.
spec.read_first: coord_get_task_result {prev} with fields ["verdict", "evidence", "pointers", "summary"]; the case's intent is {intent}.
constraints: Nothing sends: write the body to a file and return the draft_reply envelope.
The body ends with 'Thanks!' and no name; Ben's Outlook signature carries it.
Promise nothing no task covers; if the answer needs more work, put it in follow_ups instead.

steps.name: Send
steps.means: Ben sends the reply; that closes the case.
